title: SMB2: Support for asynchronous communications
description:
o Support for req/resp with async IDs (aid), Cancel requests, and
  STATUS_PENDING responses.
o Provides new SRT for:
	1. Notify req to STATUS_PENDING
	2. Cancel req to Notify STATUS_CANCELLED
o Fixes bug where the frame number in response_to was incorrect.

Why do you have this assumption that the Message ID field can't be zero? This test is what is causing the tests to fail, because in `test/captures/smb311-aes-256-ccm.pcap.gz` the message ID of the Negotiate Protocol Request and its matching Negotiate Protocol Response are both 0.
